items.name: addRavenDB
items.description: Adds a RavenDB server resource to the application model. A container is used for local development. This overload simplifies the configuration by creating an unsecured RavenDB server resource with default settings.
items.remarks:
Note: When using this method, a valid RavenDB license must be provided as an environment variable
before calling the `Build` and `Run` methods.
You can set the license by calling:
```
builder.WithEnvironment("RAVEN_License", "{your license}");
```
items.returns: A resource builder for the newly added RavenDB server resource.
